name: hud_layout_base_load_type_i_from_zar_root
description: HudLayoutBase::LoadTypeIFromZarRoot finds the TYPEI node, reads its first rectangle payload into layoutRect, and copies that rectangle into activeRect.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD layout/source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x412c10 validates zReader_GetNamedNode(parent, "TYPEI"), calling HudUiLayoutNode::ReadRectOffsetAndSize on the first TYPEI payload node, copying layoutRect to activeRect, and preserving both rectangles when TYPEI is absent.

The native smoke builds a minimal ZRD-style TYPEI node tree, verifies layoutRect and activeRect receive the same LTRB rectangle, and verifies a missing TYPEI node leaves existing rectangles unchanged.
